Script smart light control with ChatGPT
A commenter hooked ChatGPT up to their home automation system, where it writes scripts to control their smart lights.
Done with
GP
ChatGPT
What they did
The source only says the poster connected ChatGPT to their home automation system and had it write scripts for smart-light control. It does not describe the automation platform, what access ChatGPT had, whether anything ran automatically, or what human review happened before the scripts were used.
How it went
The reported result is simply that the scripts were pretty decent. No examples, performance numbers, or failures are given in the post or visible comments.
Try it yourself
with
ChatGPT
Copy prompt
I use [Home Assistant / other smart home system] and have these lights: [list light names or entity IDs]. Write me a working script that [describe behavior, e.g. dims the living room lights to 30% at sunset], with comments explaining where to paste it and how to test it. Keep it to one script, tell me anything I need to change for my setup, and don't assume device names you haven't been given.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/ChatGPT/comments/1sj0h8j/anyone_using_chatgpt_to_automate_repetitive_tasks
